_comment: How Adopt-a-Pet names things. Every key here comes from the field list recorded on issue #40, recovered from the lynnaloo/adopt-a-pet Node client and corroborated by the FetchFree API directory entry. NOTHING here has been confirmed against a live account — the official spec at adoptapet.com/public/apis/pet_list.html returns 401, and this project's rules confine requests to the local install. Treat it as a shape to build against, not as truth. Fields Adopt-a-Pet has no visible equivalent for (weight, microchip_id, numerical_age, adoption_fee, hypoallergenic, coat_pattern, secondary/tertiary colour, and the whole bonded-pair concept) are deliberately absent: unmapped hydrates to '' and the renderers omit the row. good_with_cats is the consequential unknown — the reference client reads dogs and kids but not cats, so our compatibility triad is missing a leg until an account can confirm it.
label: Adopt-a-Pet
